caption:
रामायण के अंत में सनी देओल का धमाका देख फैन्स हुए गदगद!

सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होते ही रामायण ने मचाया तहलका।
फिल्म के एंड क्रेडिट्स में सनी देओल लॉर्ड हनुमान के अवतार में दिखे।
मेकर्स का मानना है कि यह एंट्री थिएटर में गजब का माहौल बनाएगी।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक सनी देओल का यह सीन दूसरे पार्ट के लिए एक्साइटमेंट बढ़ाएगा।
फिल्म के सोर्स का दावा है कि इसका मकसद दर्शकों को बाहुबली जैसा सस्पेंस देना है।
यह सीक्वेंस फिल्म के बिल्कुल अंत में आता है जो दर्शकों को हैरान कर देगा। 🤩🔥

क्या आप सनी देओल को हनुमान के किरदार में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? 👇

ctx.title: CONFIRMED: Sunny Deol makes a ROCKING entry as Lord Hanuman during Ramayana’s end credits
ctx.summary: The much-awaited Ramayana has finally released in cinemas and, as expected, the film is dominating headlines everywhere. Previews have been underway in India for the past few days, and the reactions have further raised the expectations of the makers as well as the trade. Interestingly, the film ends on a high note with the much-awaited entry of superstar Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. Sunny Deol’s entry is expected to be a major mass-appeal moment and could lead to a frenzy in cinemas. This crucial sequence unfolds while the end credits roll, setting the stage beautifully for an equally exciting second part. Interestingly, Bollywood Hungama was among the first to inform readers that Sunny Deol would appear only in the end of the first part. On September 1, we published an article in which a source had revealed, “Sunny Deol appears in Ramayana Part 1 only towards the very end. In fact, the film concludes with his appearance. It could either be the final scene before the end credits roll or be presented as a mid-credit or post-credit sequence…The idea is to leave the audience on a massive high, much like the ending of the first Baahubali. The ‘Kattappa ne Baahubali ko kyun maara?’ moment created tremendous curiosity and considerably amplified the excitement for the second film. Similarly, the makers of Ramayana are hoping that the introduction of Lord Hanuman at the end of Part 1 will create a frenzy in cinemas and leave audiences eagerly waiting for the sequel.” Also Read: Allu A
ctx.text:
The much-awaited Ramayana has finally released in cinemas and, as expected, the film is dominating headlines everywhere. Previews have been underway in India for the past few days, and the reactions have further raised the expectations of the makers as well as the trade. Interestingly, the film ends on a high note with the much-awaited entry of superstar Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman.
Sunny Deol’s entry is expected to be a major mass-appeal moment and could lead to a frenzy in cinemas. This crucial sequence unfolds while the end credits roll, setting the stage beautifully for an equally exciting second part.
Interestingly, Bollywood Hungama was among the first to inform readers that Sunny Deol would appear only in the end of the first part. On September 1, we published an article in which a source had revealed, “Sunny Deol appears in Ramayana Part 1 only towards the very end. In fact, the film concludes with his appearance. It could either be the final scene before the end credits roll or be presented as a mid-credit or post-credit sequence…The idea is to leave the audience on a massive high, much like the ending of the first Baahubali . The ‘Kattappa ne Baahubali ko kyun maara ?’ moment created tremendous curiosity and considerably amplified the excitement for the second film. Similarly, the makers of Ramayana are hoping that the introduction of Lord Hanuman at the end of Part 1 will create a frenzy in cinemas and leave audiences eagerly waiting for the sequel.”
